titolo: Alaska Is Hiding Something Most Americans Never Notice

scene.testo: Alaska is bigger than Texas, California and Montana combined.
Yet fewer than 750,000 people live there.
But the real secret isn't size.
Alaska has more coastline than all other states combined.
Fjords, islands and bays twist along its shores.
It holds more than three million lakes.
Yet most of its land has no roads.
Even the state capital, Juneau, cannot be reached by road.
Boats and planes connect it to the world.
Glaciers here grind valleys like slow rivers of ice.
Denali rises 20,310 feet, North America's tallest peak.
Dozens of volcanoes here are still active.
Near Utqiagvik, the winter sun vanishes for two months.
But that's not the strangest part.
Under the ground, much of Alaska is permanently frozen.
That frozen layer is called permafrost.
And as it thaws, the land itself starts changing.
Roads buckle, trees lean, and ice turns to mud.
Stay with me, because this reaches far beyond Alaska.
